transport: stdio via official SDK; negotiate supported MCP protocol

tools.name: archmeld_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a registered project, frozen snapshot, job, or record by authorized ID. No filesystem traversal.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_query
tools.description: Search symbols/text or query bounded neighbors, paths and impact. Relations include basis and evidence.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_context
tools.description: Build a bounded, snapshot-bound context package with evidence, counterclaims and explicit omissions.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_source
tools.description: Read an authorized source anchor in its original snapshot, not an arbitrary local path.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_analyze
tools.description: Request approved adapters for an existing snapshot; may require execution permission.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_architecture
tools.description: Submit candidate architecture or evidence-linked claim. No source mutation or acceptance authority.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_plan
tools.description: Propose a draft plan or behavior contract. Frozen/approved fields cannot be granted by the caller.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_change
tools.description: Submit a bounded change proposal using artifact digests; core creates draft only.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_change_action
tools.description: Prepare/apply/recover only with existing applicable authorization. Never approve own work.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_run
tools.description: Register a scenario or run it with existing authorization and resource limits.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_verify
tools.description: Run immutable contract checks on the specified actual snapshot.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_import_trace
tools.description: Import an already authorized artifact. Binding must be evidenced, not asserted by model.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_report
tools.description: Export an offline report with explicit source/raw-data inclusion permissions.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a job owned by this project; does not imply transactional rollback.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_status
tools.description: Report the registered project, latest snapshot, counts, languages and read-only workspace freshness. Creates no snapshot and records no drift.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; hints are not authorization

tools.name: archmeld_review
tools.description: Statically review the registered workspace against a frozen snapshot. No build, test or runtime command is executed.
tools.x-authority: same core checks as HTTP; the workspace root comes only from the registered project, never a caller path

output_policy: structured result of mapped operation plus a bounded text summary; tool errors reflect Error; no raw secrets or huge artifacts

implementation.tools_list_source: implemented handler registry; this declaration does not make a tool callable
implementation.note: Write operations exist in the core/HTTP surface but require an external grant; the stdio bridge cannot self-approve and does not advertise them as callable.
